paite: "Ngai in, ani ahong tun ziak in, meiphualpi bang in akuang a; huchi in kisatheite tengteng, gilou nasemte tengteng, buhpawl ahi ding uh; huan ahong tung huai ni in amaute zung leh hiang nuse lou hial in akangmang ding uh," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
heading: TOUPA Thukhen Vaihawmna
english: “For, behold, the day comes, it burns as a furnace; and all the proud, and all who work wickedness, will be stubble; and the day that comes will burn them up,” says Yahweh of Armies, “that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.

paite: Himahleh nou ka min kihtate kiang ah diktatna ni, akhate ahihdamna toh ahong suak ding; huchi in na pawtkhe ding ua, huangsung bawngnoute bang in na diang velhvelh ding uhi.
english: But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out, and leap like calves of the stall.

paite: Huan giloute na sikden ding ua; ka gamtat ni chiang in na khepek nuai uah meivu hi ding ahih ziak un, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: You shall tread down the wicked; for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I make,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: "Horeb a Israel tengteng a ding a ka sikha Mosi Dan, amah thupiak, dan thusehte leh vaihawmte ngei, theigige un.
heading: Theigige Dia Sapna
english: “Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.

paite: Ngai un, TOUPA ni thupi leh mulkimhuai ahong tun ma in na kiang uah zawlnei Elijah ka hon sawl ding hi.
english: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.

paite: Pate lungtang tate lam ah, tate lungtang apate uh lam ah angasak ding; huchi lou in zaw hamsia in lei ka gawt kha ding hi.”
english: He will turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers, lest I come and strike the earth with a curse.”
